title: Iranian Parliamentary Committee Advances Bill to Bar US, Israeli Ships From Hormuz
detail: Iran's semi-official Fars news agency reported that a parliamentary committee is reviewing a preliminary bill that would bar US, Israeli and other 'hostile' vessels from transiting the Strait of Hormuz, with fines of up to 20% of a ship's cargo value for violations. Foreign vessels would also be barred from carrying any Israel-affiliated cargo, military or civilian. A lawmaker said the draft was still under expert review, running in parallel to — but separate from — Iran's ongoing shipping-corridor talks with Oman.

media.caption: Iran aims to ban US and Israeli ships from the Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll

title: Trump Says US Has 'Massive Amounts' of Munitions Amid Low Stockpile Reports
detail: President Trump said the US has 'massive amounts' of munitions, pushing back on reports that American weapons stockpiles were running low after more than five months of sustained operations against Iran. The assertion preceded an Aug 9 Defense Department memo urging military contractors to ramp up production, which coincided with reports the Strategic Petroleum Reserve had fallen to its lowest level since 1983.

media.caption: Trump says US has 'massive amounts' of munitions after reports of low stockpile
